test:integration.notes: STRICT, AND IT MUST STAY THAT WAY. farm-service:test is already quarantined below, so this is the ONLY strict farm-service gate in ci-affected. Seeding farm-service here would leave the service with no blocking test gate at all and would re-create the dead-lane condition (FARM-MEDIUM-301) this target was wired up to end. If an integration suite is failing, fix the suite or the code it caught — do not quarantine the target.
